message: Deterministic transcript-backed outputs remain the canonical review layer for Meta Q3 2022.
Audio, NLP, and visual layers are supporting-only reviewer context and do not override transcript-backed outputs.
Missing, weak, or suppressed support layers must stay explicit rather than being normalized into a stronger read.
Heuristic visual output is context only and must not be presented as corroboration or proof.
The package does not make predictive-edge, return, or trading-value claims.
The package does not make statistical-significance claims.
